summary: Iteration 3 (Northstar GRC) — full backend + frontend E2E for Notifications, Policy Approvals, CSV Exports, and Evidence-in-Drawer. 47/47 pytest tests passed (16 new iter3 + 31 regression). Backend verified: GET /api/notifications returns {items,unread}; @mention in comment ('@contributor@acme.demo') creates a mention-type notification for the target user with title containing 'mentioned'; /api/reviews/{id}/create-finding with owner_id != caller creates finding_assigned notification for the owner; /api/findings/{id}/create-task with assignee_id != caller creates task_assigned notification; /api/notifications/{nid}/read + /api/notifications/read-all zero the unread count. Policy approval endpoints: POST /policies/{id}/submit-review flips status draft→in_review with approval_history entry {action:'submitted'}; approve with {comment:'LGTM'} sets status='approved', approved_at, approver_id and pushes history {action:'approved',comment:'LGTM'}; reject with {reason:'X'} moves status back to 'draft' and pushes {action:'rejected',reason:'X'}. RBAC: client_readonly cannot submit-review (403), client_readonly cannot approve (403), client_contributor cannot approve or reject (403). CSV exports: /api/export/reviews, /api/export/findings, /api/export/exceptions all return Content-Type text/csv, Content-Disposition attachment; header row includes review_id,title,status,review_type,recurrence,due_date for reviews. Evidence linked to record: POST /api/evidence with linked_type='review'+linked_id creates and GET /api/evidence?client_id=&linked_type=review&linked_id= returns it. Regression: /api/dashboard, /api/related, baseline, exceptions, quick actions, cron/overdue-reminders and reminders/send-now all still green. Frontend Playwright verified: sidebar notification-bell visible with notification-unread-count badge; opening dropdown shows notification-mark-all which clears unread (badge disappears); /reviews and /findings both have export-*-button and clicking export-reviews-button triggers a browser download of reviews-YYYY-MM-DD.csv; opening a review row's drawer exposes tab-evidence with drawer-evidence-dropzone + drawer-evidence-input; created a draft policy and drove full approval workflow via UI: policy-submit-review -> in_review, policy-approve, policy-reject/policy-reject-reason/policy-reject-confirm sends back to draft, then submit + approve again succeeds with toast 'Policy approved'. Notification items list populated (3 items visible after actions).

issues: After approve/reject/resubmit cycles the drawer's Approval History block does not always show newly-appended entries until the drawer is closed and reopened. The local `record` prop is not refetched after policyAction — consider awaiting a refetch of the single policy in policyAction() and setting the drawer's local record so history renders live.

design_issues.screen: RecordDrawer date fields (carried over from iter2)
issues: Approved on / Next review date <input type=date> still receive full ISO strings — slice to YYYY-MM-DD to remove the console warning.

Status field is a required-looking Select but not defaulted to 'draft'. A newly-saved policy without a chosen status becomes ''/unknown, which hides all approval buttons (they only render when status==='draft'). Suggest defaulting status to 'draft' on the client (or on the backend POST /api/policies) so submit-review is always available for freshly created policies.

action_items: (minor UX) Refetch policy record after policyAction() so approval_history renders new entries without reopening the drawer.
(minor UX) Default policy.status to 'draft' when creating a new policy from the drawer (or on backend POST /api/policies) so policy-submit-review is visible immediately after save.
(cosmetic, iter2 carry-over) Slice ISO datetime -> YYYY-MM-DD when binding to <input type="date">.
(a11y, iter2 carry-over) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to Sheet/Dialog content.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1355 lines. Extract notifications, policy-approval, and export/CSV into their own modules; the file is well past the recommended 700-line threshold.
Notifications list endpoint has no pagination — capped at 50 with sort by created_at desc and no cursor. If a user accumulates >50, older ones are silently invisible.

@mention regex `@[\w.+\-@]+` matches @email but also generic tokens. Users are matched by exact case-insensitive email OR name equality only; this means '@rob' won't match name 'Rob Bashea' (multi-word). Consider matching by name prefix or by explicit user_id after client-side autocomplete for reliable mentions.
Policy approval endpoints hard-code role check `('super_admin','platform_admin')` — the RBAC scheme is duplicated across approve/reject. Extract a small helper `_can_approve_policy(user)` for DRY.

CSV export loads up to 10 000 rows into memory before streaming a single chunk (`iter([output.getvalue()])`). For very large clients this defeats StreamingResponse. Consider a real generator yielding row-by-row.
CSV export writes list/dict fields via `str(v)` which produces Python-repr strings inside CSV cells (e.g., "['a','b']") — messy for spreadsheets. Serialize with JSON or join with a delimiter.
POST /api/policies (generic entity create) does not default `status` — see UI bug above. Add a per-kind defaults map or a Pydantic post-init default.

CORS still `allow_origins=['*']` with `allow_credentials=False`; login endpoint's Set-Cookie is dead code under these settings (frontend uses Bearer). Remove the misleading cookie or switch to credentialed CORS with explicit origins (called out in iter2 too).
No brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook item, called out iter2). Tech debt.
